## Order and release gates

`H-M0-002 coordination → H-M0-003 Data → H-M0-004 Research → H-M0-005 Quant → H-M0-006 Risk → frozen Skeptic re-review`

Risk consumes Data, Research and Quant directly; Quant consumes both Data and Research. Sequential order is deliberately stricter than conceptual dependency independence because schemas, validator and tests are shared. No parallel writable work or additional sessions are activated by this plan.

1. **Data first:** consume H-M0-003 v2 after this coordination commit is on origin/main. Produce typed content-bound manifests/observations/features, canonical sample membership, exact references and acyclic dependencies, quarantine primitives, accepted-history comparison, identifier/version rules, project-state schema and source/time evidence rules. Reject missing/altered/wrong-type content, unknown or late availability, evaluation leakage, cycles/orphans, invalid permissions, future completed facts and rewrite/deletion of published identities. Demonstrate a reconstructible synthetic dataset, valid correction preserving the original, and typed dependencies usable by later owners. Deliver API/schema compatibility notes, tests and a content-hashed inventory anchored to a full commit. No external source acquisition.
2. **Research next:** begins only after Data's completed handoff, landed commit and artifacts are verified and Director records release. Produce structured exploratory ancestry, exposure disclosure, frozen hypothesis/thresholds, first-results-access and unexamined-population contracts using Data membership identities. Add synthetic positive/negative fixtures and reject retroactive or mutated preregistration. Specify overlap rejection and evidence needed by Quant; no strategy research. Research cannot approve its own confirmation protocol for operational use.
3. **Quant next:** requires landed Data and Research completion packages. Implement exact immutable reproduction bundles, code/config/environment/input/output resolution, complete trial inventories and sample/split exposure checks. Reject hidden failed trials, missing or changed evidence, identical/renamed/partially overlapping examined outcomes and post-result threshold edits. Reproduce a fresh synthetic holdout deterministically; never execute untrusted commands merely because a record contains them. Outcome claims remain synthetic.
4. **Risk last:** requires all three preceding packages and stable contracts. Implement bounded event-derived lifecycle/eligibility, review authority, STOP resolution/propagation integration, project-state reconciliation and operational freshness contracts. Reject skip/resurrection/conflict/stale-review paths, same actor/alias self-review, unauthorized approvals, arbitrary-file/self STOP clearance, missing safety state and operational paper eligibility under the active STOP. Test a fully evidenced synthetic positive path in an isolated fixture without clearing the real STOP. Any ledger/kill-switch APIs introduced require idempotency, liabilities, correlation, stale/corrupt state, global precedence and pending-authorization race tests. No real portfolio changes, trading loops, live adapters or live approval. Stage partial work explicitly if acceptance cannot be completed; a design-only report cannot satisfy an enforcement finding.
5. **Skeptic:** independently review frozen integrated evidence and all eight findings; see re-review gate below.

Each release requires a versioned completion handoff, exact landing SHA on origin/main, artifact paths/hashes, interface notes, executed command/output report, new positive and rejection tests, and honest unresolved findings. The downstream claim records the exact completed prerequisite versions and SHA; dependency IDs alone are not authorization. Director release certifies readiness for dependent remediation only, never scientific approval or STOP clearance.

## Minimum credible authority and history boundary

Current assurance is distinct reported sessions and inspectable Git history, not authenticated human identities. A shared OS account or Git author field cannot establish independence. No branch protection or external credential boundary has been verified here.

Risk must implement a verifier-supplied trust policy outside the submitted evidence set: canonical actor IDs, alias mapping, authorized roles/scope, validity/revocation, conflicts and evidence-bound attestations. Each attestation binds reviewer, subject/evidence digests, policy, decision, scope, validity and author disclosures. An author-controlled JSON actor/role list is not a trusted policy. Reject absent trust configuration, unmapped/duplicate aliases, self-review, stale/revoked authority, scope/hash mismatch and forged Risk claims. Positive tests may inject a synthetic trusted policy; they prove checks under that assumption, not real identity.

At current maturity, a separately controlled owner/reviewer attestation channel or verifier configuration is required before any operational approval can be trusted. It has not been provisioned. Until its separation is demonstrated, operational authorization must deny. No one should claim an in-repository allowlist, session ID, Git attribution or unsigned file authenticates a person. OS compromise, colluding authorized reviewers, false external observations and off-system undisclosed exploration remain outside local guarantees and must be documented.

Data must compare immutable records against a verifier-selected full baseline SHA/content inventory that candidates cannot replace by editing their own records. Pin `4e99cfac90e0af601158c1528c70574dd5dafeda` as the initial published-history preservation reference, not as scientifically approved evidence. New snapshots need explicit external acceptance, content digests and predecessor linkage; never automatically bless current HEAD or a movable ref. Distinguish mutable project summaries from immutable audits, STOPs, hypotheses, experiments and published handoffs. Reject deletion/mutation, supersession cycles/orphans and baseline replacement. Preserve old schema versions or provide explicit validated migration without rewriting originals. Comparison detects changes relative to the supplied baseline; it cannot protect a baseline or verifier that the same adversary controls. Without a credible trusted baseline, report unavailable assurance and deny affected acceptance.

## Tests, known gaps and re-review

The user explicitly forbids modifying, inverting, skipping or deleting Skeptic's probes to get green results. That instruction supersedes the original review/handoffs' suggestion to replace acceptance assertions. Preserve the original file byte-for-byte. Add separate owner rejection regressions using valid fixtures with one targeted violation, so accidental parse/schema errors cannot masquerade as fixed controls. Map each original attack to new tests and preserve positive paths.

Baseline: 33 tests pass, including unsafe-acceptance characterization probes; this is not approval. As fixes land, original acceptance probes may fail against the changed validator. Run and report full discovery honestly; do not skip them or claim green. Reproduce the unchanged suite against the pinned review baseline in a separate disposable checkout, and run new regressions against the candidate. Record each failure and whether it demonstrates the intended denial or a broken fixture. Unexplained failures block progression. A documented expected characterization mismatch permits dependent remediation only; it does not satisfy independent acceptance. Any permanent suite migration or disputed probe goes to Skeptic for a separately documented decision consistent with the owner's no-rewrite instruction.

Request an interim Skeptic opinion for disputed attacks or changes to trust/contracts before dependent work relies on them. Request full re-review only after all owners have landed frozen completion packages, all original attacks have explicit new rejection/positive evidence, history/trust limitations are documented, preservation checks pass and no unexplained failures remain. Director assembles the full SHA, evidence inventory, test dispositions and finding-to-test matrix; Skeptic independently reproduces it. All eight findings require a disposition; none are silently waived.

STOP-M0-001 can be resolved only through issuer or documented independent-substitute review, affected domain approvals, Risk approval where capital is implicated, revalidated descendants and a separate typed evidence-linked resolution event. Director does not clear it. Full re-review or a green suite alone is not clearance, M0 exit, paper authorization or capital unlock.
